name: Easy Prep Tax & Accounting
what_they_do: CPA firm that now trades as Veritas Planning Advisors, led by founder Jay Patadia, CPA: tax preparation and planning, bookkeeping, payroll, business consulting, cloud accounting, retirement planning and part-time CFO services. Markets itself as a 'proactive, tech-forward' firm serving professionals and growing businesses such as medical practices, law firms and SaaS companies.
customers: Busy professionals and owners of growing small businesses (medical practices, law firms, SaaS/tech companies), plus individual taxpayers.

size_signals.signal: Founder-led firm with a team ('our team is here to simplify the numbers'), publishing a 12-hour response policy and cloud tooling
Company job-board profile exists on Workable for Veritas Planning Advisors - CPA (inference: hiring/growing; open roles not confirmed)
Easy Prep listing carries 40 reviews on Birdeye, indicating an established client base before the rebrand

listing.platform: Birdeye profile for 'Easy Prep Tax & Accounting - CPA', New Brunswick (Google reviews aggregated; Google not viewed directly)

website_review.primary_cta: 'Book a call' / 'Schedule a call' and click-to-call phone in the header
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: No online calendar; contact form plus 'schedule a call' prompt (the form itself requires agreeing to create an account)
website_review.trust_signals: Founder bio and credentials, client testimonials with ages, named service pages, explicit 12-hour response policy, 'Powered by CountingWorks PRO' platform, current 2026 copyright
website_review.out_of_date_signs: The Pricing page in the main nav renders with no pricing content at all (footer only); the old domain www.easyprepcpa.com serves an invalid/expired TLS certificate, so anyone typing the old address hits a browser security warning before the redirect; the Easy Prep brand name is still used by reviewers but absent from the site
website_review.search_basics: Good: unique page titles per service, meta description naming Somerville NJ and the phone, LocalBusiness + AccountingService JSON-LD matching the address, service pages for each offering. Weakness: nothing targets New Brunswick, and schema has no hours, service list or price range
top_issues: Brand/address split: the batch's New Brunswick address (317 George St, Suite 320) does not appear anywhere on the current site, which lists only 94 Grove Street, Somerville - so New Brunswick customers following old listings are routed 25 miles north (inference: the office was consolidated at the rebrand).

The www.easyprepcpa.com domain, still cited in directories and by old clients, throws a certificate error (ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID) before redirecting - a visible 'not secure' warning for anyone using the old name.

Booking is friction-heavy: the contact form includes reCAPTCHA and an 'I agree to the creation of an account' consent, and the Pricing menu item opens a page with no pricing, so prospects cannot self-qualify or pick a time.

agent_readiness.notes: LocalBusiness/AccountingService JSON-LD present and consistent with the address and phone, services written as crawlable text with dedicated pages, and the site is responsive with tel: links. But hours are absent from the page and the schema, there is no price information despite a Pricing page, and the contact form sits behind reCAPTCHA with an account-creation consent - an agent can submit a lead, not book.

operations_signals.signal: Firm publicly promises replies within 12 hours - inference: response time is a managed, staffed process and a natural target for an intake/follow-up agent.
Sells part-time CFO, payroll and bookkeeping retainers to practices and SaaS firms - high-value recurring clients with document-heavy onboarding.

Two separate brand identities (Easy Prep listings/reviews vs Veritas website) with no cross-reference on-site - inference: duplicate listings and inconsistent Google Business Profiles are splitting local visibility and reviews.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Consolidate the brand online: fix/redirect the expired easyprepcpa.com certificate, merge or de-duplicate the Easy Prep and Veritas Google listings, and state clearly which office serves New Brunswick clients.
top_opportunities.evidence: Old domain shows ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID; the site lists only Somerville while directories still publish the New Brunswick address and 40 Easy Prep reviews.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add real online scheduling (calendar with real slots) and remove the account-creation consent + reCAPTCHA from the primary contact path, keeping a labelled short form.
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page has a 10-field form with reCAPTCHA and a consent to 'the creation of an account'; no calendar anywhere.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Publish actual pricing tiers (the Pricing page is empty) and add hours/service-area to schema so prospects and their assistants can qualify before booking.
top_opportunities.evidence: vpacpa.com/pricing renders only header/footer; JSON-LD has address and phone but no hours, price range or service list.

scores.reasons: The live site is modern and well built, so most gaps are around the stale Easy Prep identity (broken cert, split listings, missing New Brunswick presence) rather than the site itself; a growing CPA firm selling CFO retainers can pay, and the fixes are small.
